author: Written by coder session 92f609a7042a (lopdev team, PR #1603 receipts slice) on the auditors' behalf, transcribed from each auditor session's final report (the auditors wrote no receipt and no ledger row). auditor.model_note: Model name is the auditor session's own header/usage record (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, provider anthropic on every turn of the session transcript); the auditor reports it cannot verify the runtime provider and claims no fallback. No fallback was verified or ruled out.

independence: The auditor(s) are separate i18n-auditor sessions from the translator (session 3c0d98370d76, job f701c763e4bb) and from the remediation translator (session 634c73fee13a, job 70c2d5eecc5d); neither auditor translated, edited or remediated any string, and neither wrote a receipt or ledger row. The translator, remediator and auditors share one model (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5), so independence is by agent and session, not by model family; a shared blind spot is possible (the hi round-1 auditor states this explicitly). Independence is attested by the auditors' own reports and the session transcripts; it is not provable from this file alone. Job-to-session mapping for round 2 (job -> auditor session) was read from the parent transcript, where each delta report follows its launching job id; round-1 jobs are identified by session id only.

locale_level_round1_verdict.note: Locale-level verdict covered all 17 namespaces of the locale. Each namespace block below carries its own status derived from its own findings.

reported_hash_check: Every full sha256 the round-2 delta auditor reported for this locale matched the git-object hash recomputed by the coder; round-1 auditors reported 16-hex prefixes that matched at ab45351362a.
finding_attribution: Findings are split per namespace and key so each ledger row counts its own; one auditor finding spanning several namespaces is counted once per namespace it touches, so the sum can exceed the auditor's headline totals. Only OPEN findings (unapplied at 011c0f4f4ca, or raised by the round-2 auditor on the new text) are counted; fixed ones are listed under resolved_findings.
